info.name: Instock API reference Articles Moves API

params.name: site_id
params.description: ID of Instock site. Globally unique.

params.name: start_cursor
params.description:
Cursor returned from a previous response, 
used to request the next page of the results.

params.name: page_size
params.description:
The number of articles returned in response. 
Default (minimum) value is 10, maximum value is 1000.

items.docs:
Returns a paginated list of all moves for all articles within specific site.

**Note**:  Results are sorted in a descending order of their timestamps, meaning the latest results are displayed first.

params.name: site_id
params.description: ID of Instock site. Globally unique.

params.name: article_id
params.description: ID of an article. Unique in scope of your organization(s).

params.name: start_cursor
params.description:
Cursor returned from a previous response, 
used to request the next page of the results.

params.name: page_size
params.description:
The number of articles returned in response. 
Default (minimum) value is 10, maximum value is 1000.

items.docs:
Returns a paginated list of all moves of a single article within a specific site.

**Note**:  Results are sorted in a descending order of their timestamps, meaning the latest results are displayed first.
